hindi_transcript: Yeh pure Banarasi katan silk dupatta hai, hath se buna hua gold zari ke sath, do din lage banane me, 350 rupaye ka kacha mal laga.
english_translation: This is a pure Banarasi Katan silk dupatta, handwoven with gold zari, took 2 days to make, raw material cost Rs 350.

hindi_transcript: Yeh purani dhokra mitti aur pital ki technique se bana traditional tribal diya hai, 6 ghante lage, 180 ka pital laga.
english_translation: This is a traditional tribal brass lamp made using the lost-wax technique, took 6 hours, Rs 180 raw alloy used.

hindi_transcript: Yeh handmade Jaipur blue pottery ka flower vase hai, natural cobalt blue colour aur multani mitti se bana, 5 ghante lage.
english_translation: This is a handmade Jaipur blue pottery flower vase, made with natural cobalt blue pigment and Multani clay, took 5 hours.
